title: phase_membrane SIBD replicates on seeds 7-8; its L ring fails in the uniform-D Laplacian twin, its division does not
summary: Fresh-seed labkit reruns (seeds 7, 8): walled cells condense from noise, 12 and 7 persistent splits, max generation 4 and 3; per-cell L ring (rim within 2 px of the wall over the deep core) 2.32 at 1x and 2.42 at 2x (seed 7). Matched Laplacian-only twin (gate=0, chi=0, D_K and D_L uniform x lam; twin_pm.py): at lam 0.1 it forms and divides walled cells from noise (26 persistent splits) but the ring is 1.16; at lam 0.001 the ring is 1.85 at 1x with lattice-locked cells, and at 2x the twin's cells hollow into catalyst-free L arcs that fragment, falling from 18 to 3 measurable cells, while the world is unchanged at 2x. So B is beyond diffusion in this world and D is not.

observations.S: rerun/seed7/sheet.png t=0: smoothed noise everywhere, cells by t=350
observations.I: rerun/seed7/tracks.png: tracks #60, #84, #88 followed as discrete walled cells for 3000-5000 t
observations.B: ring/world_s7.json: per-cell L rim/deep core 2.32 (1.97-2.54 over t=2000-8000); 2.42 at 2x (ring/world_x2_s7.json); bright smooth L rim at the wall in rerun/seed7/tracks.png
observations.D: rerun/SUMMARY.md: persistent splits 12 and 7, max generation 4 and 3 (seeds 7, 8)

controls_run.B: twin_lam01/ and ring/twin_lam01_s7.json (ring 1.16); twin_lam0001/ and ring/twin_lam0001_s7.json (1.85, lattice-locked); twin_lam0001_x2/ and ring/twin_lam0001_x2_s7.json (2x: hollow fragmenting L arcs, cells 18 -> 3)
controls_run.D: twin_lam01/ (26 persistent splits): the twin also divides

verdicts.limitation: The twin is one kinetic setting (the world's own) with D_K, D_L scaled uniformly; at lam 0.001 it does keep a 1.85 ring with division at 1x, and I call that a lattice effect on the strength of the square cell shapes and the 2x run (one seed here, two in 20261025T0731-c01-phase-membrane-bd-twin). At lam 0 a ring of about 2 appears in a frozen population. The ring is the drift's work: the gated world with chi=0 also loses it (1.14, parent finding). Division (D), I and S survive the twin, so only B is diffusion-tested.
